title: toolkit.json: manifest at the top of a toolkit archive
description: Written by FleetLedger when it packs one of your toolkits to send to a Ship (fleetledger/toolkitpack.py); read by `ship-ctl toolkit apply`, which refuses the archive unless its files match content_sha256 (contracts/toolkit.md).

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of one line per file in the archive but toolkit.json, sorted by path (UTF-8 bytes): "<file sha256> <755|644> <path>\n". Its first 12 characters name the release on the Ship.

created_at.description: UTC, RFC 3339, with a Z suffix.
